title: C1.2 Event Message (DR to AI, HTTP primary / UDP fallback)
description: One discrete patrol event. Delivered via HTTP POST /api/events (primary) or, if DR cannot do HTTP, the identical JSON sent 3x over UDP to the telemetry port, deduplicated by (patrol_id, event_seq). See 01-interface-contracts.md §C1.2.

patrol_id.description: YYYYMMDD_HHMM, constant for the whole patrol. Same value as the patrol's telemetry.

event_seq.description: Monotonic from 0 per patrol, independent of telemetry's seq. Basis for the idempotent dedup that makes redelivery (HTTP retry, or the 3x UDP fallback) safe.

ts_ms.description: Same clock basis as telemetry's ts_ms. See §C1.4.

zone_id.description: Present on ZONE_ENTER (the zone being entered). Omitted or null on event types that are not zone-scoped.

detail.description: Type-specific payload. PATROL_START: {route_id}. EMERGENCY_STOP: {ultra_cm}. LINE_LOST: {duration_ms}. PATROL_END: {reason: completed|user_stop|fault}. ZONE_ENTER: {} (empty).
